Ody Zhou builds at the intersection of AI and product engineering. His work spans autonomous AI agents, LLM-powered tooling, and full-stack systems — from academic research labs to enterprise engineering teams.

Designed and implemented an autonomous agent empowered by World Model for Minecraft. Published research on arXiv.

An LLM-powered automated marking tool designed for tuition centres. Evaluates student submissions, provides structured feedback, and dramatically reduces manual marking costs and workload.

### Autonomous Minecraft Agent (World Model)
Research project at Tsinghua University: an autonomous agent that uses a World Model to plan and execute long-horizon tasks in the Minecraft environment. Combines reinforcement learning with LLM-driven reasoning.
- arXiv: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2502.05907

Real-time org-wide dashboard auto-discovering Kubernetes services, surfacing live metadata, and centralizing configuration for all microservices. Built with React + Spring Boot.

## MCP Server (Model Context Protocol)

Ody's website exposes a remote MCP server that AI agents can use to contact him or book meetings.

**Endpoint:** `https://www.odyzhou.com/api/mcp`
**Transport:** Streamable HTTP (stateless)
**Discovery:** `https://www.odyzhou.com/.well-known/mcp.json`

### Available Tools

1. **`contact_ody`** — Send a message to Ody Zhou. He receives it instantly via Telegram.
   - `sender` (string, required): Your name or company
   - `message` (string, required): Your message (max 2000 chars)
   - `context` (string, optional): How you found Ody or why you're reaching out

2. **`book_meeting`** — Get a Cal.com scheduling link to book a meeting.
   - `topic` (string, optional): Meeting topic or agenda

### Client Configuration

Add to your MCP client config (Claude Desktop, Cursor, etc.):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ody-zhou": {
      "url": "https://www.odyzhou.com/api/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```
